ITEM 1 | Two rectangular slices of flatbread-style crust with golden-brown, slightly charred top edge, topped with glossy red-orange tomato sauce and patchy melted white cheese, sliced into roughly 8 cm wide by 7 cm long pieces about 1.5 cm thick, sitting on a white plate covering about 12% of the plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Second rectangular slice of the same crust and topping, with bready edge, bright red sauce and melted cheese spots, about 8 cm by 7 cm and 1.5 cm thick, adjacent to the first slice on the plate | 100

ITEM 3 | Dark brown-green crumbly mass with rough, grainy, slightly irregular surface and dull matte finish, speckled with reddish sauce on top, about 4 cm by 5 cm and roughly 2.5 cm tall, sitting beside the chicken piece, appears dry and dense | 45

ITEM 4 | Cooked drumstick-shaped piece with pale whitish-tan skin, patchy browning, glossy red sauce coating the lower end and spots, about 4 cm wide and 9 cm long with a thick meaty upper section tapering to a narrow bone end, moist-looking with slight sheen | 90

ITEM 5 | Red tomato-based sauce, glossy and thick, smeared on the chicken piece and dotted in small spots on the plate near the crust and chicken, covering a few square centimetres in total | 10
